title: Market-Conditioned JEPA: Learning from Unpredictable Market Shocks
abstract: arXiv:2611.13572v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Much of the variation in financial time series is driven by market-wide shocks that cannot be predicted from an asset's own history. Per-asset self-supervised learning treats this variation as irreducible noise. Under a latent factor model, we show that conditioning prediction on the realized market factor makes the asset's market exposure necessary for optimal prediction, while reducing the noise against which the asset-specific component is learned. Building on this insight, we introduce Market-Conditioned JEPA (MC-JEPA), a joint-embedding predictive architecture for financial time series. During training, we construct a leave-one-out market condition for each asset from the future target embeddings of other assets and incorporate it through factor loadings derived from the asset's own representation. On 11 years of minute-level Chinese A-share data, MC-JEPA improves over per-asset JEPA across nine targets spanning returns, market ex

translated_title: 市场条件化JEPA：从不可预测的市场冲击中学习
translated_abstract: 金融时间序列中的大部分变化是由市场范围的冲击驱动的，而这些冲击无法从资产自身的历史数据中预测出来。针对单一资产的自监督学习将这种变化视为不可约减的噪声。在潜在因子模型下，我们证明，将预测条件化于已实现的市场因子，使得资产的市场暴露成为最优预测的必要条件，同时降低了学习资产特定成分时需要对抗的噪声。基于这一洞察，我们提出了市场条件化JEPA（MC-JEPA），这是一种面向金融时间序列的联合嵌入预测架构。在训练过程中，我们从其他资产的未来目标嵌入中为每个资产构建留一法市场条件，并通过从资产自身表示中导出的因子载荷将其纳入模型。在11年的中国A股分钟级数据上，MC-JEPA在涵盖收益率、市场暴露等九个目标上均优于针对单一资产的JEPA。
tldr: 提出市场条件化JEPA（MC-JEPA），通过以留一法构建的市场因子作为预测条件，使资产的市场暴露成为最优预测的必要信息，并在11年中国A股分钟级数据上全面超越单一资产的JEPA方法。
en_tdlr: MC-JEPA is a joint-embedding predictive architecture that conditions prediction on a leave-one-out market factor, making asset market exposure necessary for optimal prediction and outperforming per-asset JEPA on 11 years of minute-level Chinese A-share data.
